turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, and Owen found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class, with no call to me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
"Before you came in." Not before the zero went into the gradebook. So I'll ask again: who entered that zero, and was Owen heard first?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.

Then she'll put that in writing, and I'll read it. "Policy is policy," fine: section 4.2 of your own procedure says you contact me before any mark goes in, and nobody did. I'm writing down that you said it isn't up to me.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
"A courtesy." Under 4.2 it was a requirement, and it was owed before the zero, not after. So tell me what you're relying on besides a piece of software, or I'm in the principal's office at 4:40.
